What I think that many-a-gamedev is doing when it comes to punishing players is that they're barking up the completely wrong tree. No, don't actively prevent players from playing your game - instead, invisibly force them to play against like-minded rage-quitters. If your game has matchmaking, implement a two-tiered pool system where consistent players are rewarded with being able to play with other like-minded players - and punish players who play inconsistently by dumping them into the "beta" pool with other, again, likeminded players.

It's (for the most part) a completely passive system and does a better job at not instantly telegraphing that the player is now on the shit-list and go "oh, this account's banned - time to make another one".
